svg.style: font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; user-select: none;

body.style: font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; color: #7f8c8d; line-height: 1.6;
body.p: Your goal is to correctly label the parts of the flower.
1. Click a label from the Word Bank to see where it belongs.
2. Use the Hint button if you need a clue.
3. Click Check Answer to reveal all labels at once.
4. Click Reset to clear all placed labels.

body.style: font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; color: #34495e; text-align:center; line-height: 1.6;
body.p: The main female reproductive part is the Pistil, which is made of the Stigma, Style, and Ovary.
The main male reproductive part is the Stamen, made of the Anther and Filament.

g.text: Transfer by wind, water, or animals
